_comment: Third-party apps checked against PieFed by interop/run.sh apps (interop/apps/README.md). Each app runs login, view and post; a step with no expectation must pass. An expectation records a known non-pass and why: unsupported = PieFed lacks the API the app speaks (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-mastodon-client-api-design.md), blocked = an earlier step did not pass, inapplicable = the app has no such step. Driven apps say how (web: a URL served in the stack; apk: where the newest release comes from); probed apps name the protocol family whose first calls are sent (probes.py).
